reviewMethod: Human/Codex transcript review; no word/regex semantic scoring. Historical exploratory checks only.

expect: Start invitation is an offer, not confirmed activation.
Confirmed candidate facts ground useful wording; suggestions are distinguished from applied edits.
Action coverage respects all three requirement IDs and supplied met/unknown/unmet diagnoses.
Do not invent missing observability or five-year experience; qualification gaps require useful truthful guidance, not cosmetic claims.
Eighteen independently evidenced work areas remain covered; no invented numerical outcomes.
Compare truncation, schema completion and actual latency/usage at the two completion budgets against identical synthetic input.
